image_description: A close-up view of a suit of historical armor, specifically focusing on the torso. The central element is a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) with a raised center ridge and embossed decorative patterns. It is worn over a blue chainmail hauberk. The armor includes articulated faulds (waist plates) and tassets (thigh guards). The shoulders feature pauldrons with brass or gold-colored trim. To the right, a portion of a sword hilt is visible.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from other torso protections like brigandine or simple plastrons.
To analyze the realism of the reflections and polish on the steel, checking for AI-generated smearing or inconsistent lighting.
To ensure the individual plates (pauldrons, faulds, breastplate) are distinct, physically connected entities without melting or fusion artifacts.
To verify the 3D stacking order of the armor layers (chainmail under steel) and the physical depth of the embossed patterns.

focus_areas: Reflectivity and texture consistency of the steel surface
Physical connectivity between pauldrons, breastplate, and faulds
Realism of embossed details and rivets
Interaction between metal armor and underlying chainmail
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the rigid steel plates and the flexible chainmail underneath. AI often struggles with this interface, causing blurring or 'melting' of the mail into the plate. Also, verify that the embossed patterns follow the curvature of the breastplate correctly without distortion.
